cause_quote: The new chat-tool-output.ts added `if (!output || output.outputText === undefined) { this.loadState = "unavailable"; ... }` and rendered the copy/download actions whenever loadState was not loading, regardless of empty text.
user_saw: Opening a successful image-only tool result in the Control UI showed 'Full output unavailable' and copy/download buttons that exported empty text.
summary: Treats a single matched completed tool result as available even without text, and hides copy/download actions when the output text is empty.
reasoning: The removed `loadedCard.outputText === undefined` condition and the unconditional actions block trace back through the Solid refactors (#176599, #179556) and the Lit-to-Solid migration (#168739) unchanged to the original full-output recovery component added in fd77e9230188 (#153542). That diff contains both the same undefined-text-means-unavailable check and the actions rendered for any non-loading state, so non-text results were mislabeled from the start; the fix PR notes image-only MCP results come from existing MCP conversion, not a later change.
